title: 614. Logical OR of Two Binary Grids Represented as Quad-Trees

examples.explanation: OR with all-False keeps the first grid.

hints: Rebuild both node trees from the BFS lists: leaves stop, internal nodes take the next four entries as children.
A leaf True dominates (result leaf True); a leaf False defers to the other subtree.
When both sides are internal, merge the four child pairs, then collapse uniform leaf children into one leaf.
